cycles.target: Cache repeated Lithostitched assembly terrain heights

remaining_opportunities.target: Confirm the original home-return freezes on the dedicated host
remaining_opportunities.evidence_needed: Repeat the Nether -> home workload with Auram 1.0.3 and capture Spark plus support-coordinate/chunk instrumentation if the same path stalls. The original capture contains no cached coordinates or player identity.
remaining_opportunities.risk: The synthetic regression reproduces and fixes stale support loads; it cannot prove every live 30+ second stall shares that cause.

remaining_opportunities.evidence_needed: Live identity-hit rates and a representative capability-heavy inventory A/B run; copied snapshots had 0/7680 identity hits and the tested candidate did not improve terminal timings.
remaining_opportunities.risk: Persistent results can become stale after mutable NBT/capability changes. The opt-in candidate remains test-only.

remaining_opportunities.evidence_needed: Multiworker live query traces and a cloning/lifecycle A/B benchmark. AE2 had 0 within-attempt duplicates and only 164/2499 optimistic 4096-entry hits across 12 adjacent attempts.
remaining_opportunities.risk: NoiseColumn is mutable; sharing columns or NoiseChunks can corrupt output. Cross-world, state, accessor/type and lifecycle keys plus cloning costs are required. The shipped caches stay within one assembly or one constructor mapping pass.

remaining_opportunities.target: Datapack tick functions and NBT selectors
remaining_opportunities.evidence_needed: Attribute hot commands to concrete functions and capture selector patterns plus mutation/capability behavior before changing command evaluation.
remaining_opportunities.risk: Generic entity-NBT caching can miss mutations or mod serialization behavior within the same tick. Deferred behind freezes/worldgen as requested.

remaining_opportunities.evidence_needed: Allocation/heap ownership and comparable four-CPU throughput/MSPT measurements after these patches.
remaining_opportunities.risk: The execution profile includes waits and export overhead; it does not establish a safe heap owner to trim or an optimal worker count.
